messages.en:
{07 06 00}Fossil, {01 00 00 05 00}{ff 00 00 05}{04 1f 00}{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Fossil!{01 00 00 05 00} FOSSIL!

{07 16 00}No, I didn't hit my head!
{07 06 00}I just really, REALLY want
a fossil, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 16 00}I don't care which one it
is!{01 00 00 05 00} Just bring me a fossil!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Please, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 06 00}Fossiil, {01 00 00 05 00}{ff 00 00 05}{04 1f 00}{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Fossiil!{01 00 00 05 00} FOSSIIL!

{07 16 00}Ei, ma ei löönud pead ära!
{07 06 00}Ma lihtsalt tahan VÄGA
fossiili, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 16 00}Mul ükskõik, milline see
on!{01 00 00 05 00} Lihtsalt too fossiil!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Palun, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Man, lately, all I can think
about is sweet fossils,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}See, {01 00 00 05 00}if I did sit-ups while
holding a fossil,{01 00 00 05 00}{07 13 00} it'd ROCK
my lower abs{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 16 00}So c'mon, {01 00 00 05 00}{ff 00 00 05}{04 1f 00}{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 06 00}Even a small one would
work!{01 00 00 05 00} Just help me look!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Mees, viimasel ajal mõtlen
ma ainult fossiilidele,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Vaata, {01 00 00 05 00}kui ma teeks trenni
fossiil käes,{01 00 00 05 00}{07 13 00} see RAPUTAKS
mu alakõhtu{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 16 00}Ole nüüd, {01 00 00 05 00}{ff 00 00 05}{04 1f 00}{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 06 00}Isegi väike üks
sobiks!{01 00 00 05 00} Aita lihtsalt otsida!

messages.en:
{07 0b 00}My hobby?{01 01 00} {07 15 00}It's fossil
collecting, of course!{01 00 00 05 00}
Doy!
{07 16 00}Thing is, I've been having
such a hard time finding 
one, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}...
{07 0e 00}I wish someone would go 
look for it with me,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Mu hobi?{01 01 00} {07 15 00}Muidugi
fossiilide kogumine!{01 00 00 05 00}
Doh!
{07 16 00}Asi on selles, et mul on
olnud nii raske ühte leida, 
tead, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}...
{07 0e 00}Sooviks, et keegi läheks 
koos minuga seda otsima,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
